events.title: New game mode and more
events.summary: Up to now there's been two game modes in Type the World. Keyboard Trainer mode focuses on typing with emphasis on learning the basic use of a keyboard. Type the World mode is the namesake chill mode where you get to learn geography.Now, with the all new Flash Cards game mode, the level of challenge ramps up! events.title: Demo update: Equal Earth projection and more
events.summary: Thank you for playing the Type the World demo!The demo has been updated with a few useful features:The country flag can now be displayed on the country label, placing it more directly in the field of view. This helps learning the flags.Country population and ISO country code can also be viewed on the label.The UN recently recommended the Equal Earth projection for general use, so it's been added to the game as an option.
